# InfOverlay
Info overlay lua script for the GTA V Stand mod menu.

You can find the settings for the info overlay in Players > Settings > InfOverlay Settings.

![InfOverlay](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/67374474/214446395-8f8623d4-cdb4-41cd-889b-63973b2ef5c0.PNG)

Enjoy!

# ThemeRepo
Lua script to apply headers and themes blazingly fast for Stand

**Installation**

<https://github.com/stagnate6628/stand-themerepo/releases>

Find the latest version and download `ThemeRepo.pluto` to `%appdata%\Stand\Lua Scripts`

> [!WARNING]  
> When downloading a header, the `Custom Headers` folder gets wiped.
> 
> When downloading a theme, the `Theme` and `Custom Headers` folders get wiped.
>
> Create backups as needed.

# Stand Themes A collection of my themes made for the GTA:O mod menu `Stand`. > [!NOTE] > The installation process should always be the same. > wich means: > 1. Copy the folders *Headers*, *Profiles*, *Tabs* and *Theme* into your Stand-folder. > 2. Ingame, go to Stand > Profiles > *Theme name* > Load > [!TIP] > - Some themes have alternative Headers inside a folder named *_extras*, you can replace the header by copying it to *Headers/Custom Header/* and rename it to `0.png` > - If you want to use my custom font, download `Font.spritefont` and copy it into the *Theme* folder. ## Previews ### Nocturnal [](https://github.com/hypercrites/standthemes/tree/main/Nocturnal) ### Trooper [](https://github.com/hypercrites/standthemes/tree/main/Trooper) ### HackTheBox [](https://github.com/hypercrites/standthemes/tree/main/HackTheBox)

compatibilityEvidence.scope: Source inspection only; no fresh runtime test executed

allInOne.behavior: Loads original All-in-One source into isolated theme runtime, activates theme option entries and requires custom presets to emit draws; tests demand at least 30 options.

nativeSelector.behavior: Loads candidate script from Stand/Collections and discovers original collection profiles.

limitations: Native Stand theme integration does not establish compatibility for arbitrary Stand gameplay Lua APIs.
Nenyoo theme.lua conversions are separate format and must remain separate from original Stand profiles.
Old UI is an actual named ThemeRepo profile, not evidence that it came from Discord Old Shares.

facts: Public author repository lists HackTheBox, Nocturnal, Trooper.
README documents copying Headers, Profiles, Tabs, Theme and loading the named Stand profile.
README lists the three real image previews.
